## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the change for someone who has not read the issue discussion. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

List the relevant checks or experiments you ran, their results, and any checks you could not run.

## Evidence, compatibility, and limitations

Describe public API/schema changes, evidence or adapter trust assumptions, and research limitations where relevant. Keep fixture results separate from actual model results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes documentation where behavior or interfaces changed.
- [ ] Behavioral fixes include a meaningful regression test where applicable.
- [ ] Policy and explainer inputs remain separate from evaluator truth and fault/scenario labels.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures contain only material I have permission to share, without credentials or real customer/payment records.
